body.x: From January 8, 2019 to Thursday, November 11, CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, Nevada, is recruiting companies to exhibit their products, services and technologies at 'C Space'.

In addition to television, TV, and newspapers, platform functions such as online SNS, blogs, cafes, YouTube, and Africa TV are being activated. With this trend, the number of successful cases of marketing using social media is increasing, and the competition among companies to appeal to consumers is intensifying due to innovative advertising and marketing methods. If you want to increase your brand value through marketing and advertising, and you want to grab the attention of consumers and industry stakeholders, you should focus on 'C Space' at CES.

At C Space in CES 2019 'Tech South, Aria', global innovators and marketers gather to discover the future of brand marketing and entertainment through the latest trends and technologies. Here, you can meet the world's innovators, marketers and various creatives all in one place. The companies that will be exhibiting at 'C Space' will have the opportunity to experience the latest technology related to advertising and marketing analysis, and to learn the marketing know-how of advertising companies who listen to CMO's opinions on data-based marketing and measurement.

Also, 'C Space' is a place to share ideas with technical experts in various fields such as contents and originality, and to explore how this idea affects advertising, journalism and broadcasting media. If you want to know the marketing atmosphere related to marketing and publicity, or if you want to experience new marketing technology that will lead consumers from key content creators, leading studio and advertising company leaders who will participate as keynote speakers and panelists, go file an application for C Space at CES website. You will be able to see where the future of brand marketing and entertainment changes with your own eyes.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition that can grasp the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. A global news network that most recently reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the world market, I introduce to the world.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met.
MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
